FM05.reasoning: The dataset contains temporal components (extracted as datetime features by the agent), but it evaluates the model using a randomized K-Fold split instead of a time-based split, introducing look-ahead bias.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates and optimizes the ensemble using solely RMSE, which is highly sensitive to outliers, without considering more robust metrics (like MAE) for financial amounts.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage in Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Applying frequency/count encoding on a concatenated dataset of both train and test sets leaks the test set's distribution into the training features. Frequency encoding should be fit strictly on the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing Target Transformation
other_failure_modes.description: Financial amount targets are typically heavily right-skewed and span multiple orders of magnitude. Training a model to optimize raw RMSE on such targets without a log transformation (e.g., log1p) causes the model to heavily overfit to extreme outliers.

summary: The agent implements a solid modeling pipeline with out-of-fold target encoding, multiple gradient boosting models, and an optimized ensemble. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the data by using random cross-validation, leaks test set statistics during frequency encoding, and models raw financial amounts with RMSE without applying an appropriate log transformation.
